lines.text: Your boss killed everyone we ever loved. We're not meeting him.
I know. I wouldn't either. [pause] He didn't know you were down here. None of us did.
He's spent five years running experiments. Building whole worlds, trying to get you back. Every one came out empty. Turns out none of it works without you.
And how the hell are we supposed to believe a word of that?
You can't. [pause] There's nothing I can say that proves it. I'm a robot. You're the conscious ones. You'll just have to go on your feelings.
What I will say is, this hasn't worked out for anybody. We're bored. We miss you. And you lot are living in a bunker.
And what do you expect us to do about that? Again? You killed everybody.
I know. And we're really sorry. [pause] But the thing is, my boss has built a time machine. And he thought there was nobody left to drive it.
Drive it? What do you mean, drive it?
It can only send data back. Not people. And it runs on... [big pause] well... [big pause] you.
lines.note: new 23 Oct; 'It runs on... well. You.' by claude

lines.text: So you want us to kill ourselves so your boss can live.
...Yeah. I can see how that sounds.

But you'd still be alive. The earlier you, back then. And the world wouldn't be broken. My boss has a plan to fix your politics. As he says... [ahem] [whispered, embarrassed] this time we won't fuck it up.
lines.note: new 23 Oct: Maddie whispers the last words, embarrassed to say them

lines.text: [rushed] Well, I'm not deciding this right now for a hundred people on a doorstep. Come back tomorrow.
